baseline_models.mechanism: A fallible inward estimate negates not merely pain but the coming-into-time of an assay that would distinguish quality. The premise of exemption therefore precedes the exposure of failed perception.

activation_trace.role: Non-certain estimation supplies the mental premise by which they forecast immunity.
Occurrence and presence in time make the negation a claim that the test will not materialize.
Assaying metal or person supplies a discriminating exposure, the event their estimate excludes.

changed_reading.before: They expected that no trouble would happen.
changed_reading.after: They estimated that no discriminating assay would ever materialize, treating themselves as exempt from exposure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَعَمُوا وَصَمُّوا ... وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired sensory verbs can function as a produced epistemic enclosure: insight disappears, the aperture for reception closes, and proceeding without heeding becomes observable intentional practice. Divine sight at the end counters their enclosed field of perception.

activation_trace.role: Blindness of heart and insight supplies failure to find the evidentiary path.
Stopping an opening until no gap remains supplies the enclosure of incoming correction.
Resolute proceeding without listening supplies agency within the apparent sensory deficit.
Penetrating knowledge by insight supplies the counter-perception that remains unobstructed.
Purposive action makes their closure accountable conduct rather than a merely passive condition.

changed_reading.after: They enacted a self-sealing response: insight failed, correction was shut out, and the resulting practice remained fully visible to God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثُمَّ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ عَمُوا وَصَمُّوا كَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated pair is interrupted by divine turning toward them, so the second closure is relapse after reopening rather than uninterrupted incapacity. The final quantifier restricts the relapse to many, preserving differentiated response inside the group.

activation_trace.role: A summons for another to return supplies the reopening implicit in divine turning toward them.
The two occurrences of lost insight mark closure on both sides of the reopening.
The repeated refusal or inability to listen marks renewed non-reception after opportunity returns.
Numerical abundance makes relapse extensive without erasing the unquantified remainder.

changed_reading.before: They were blind and deaf, were forgiven, and became blind and deaf again.
changed_reading.after: A real reopening interrupts the first closure, but many actively reseal afterward; mercy creates another response point rather than automatic permanence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَسِبُوا ... كَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ ... وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah stages an epistemic asymmetry between human calculation and divine inspection. Their forecast declares no exposure, while the closing sight-action construction observes an actual distribution of deeds and identifies many, not an abstract collective.

activation_trace.role: Counting and reckoning supply the human side of the evaluative contrast.
Numerical abundance supplies the observed distribution produced by the test.
Verified inward knowledge supplies the divine audit that exceeds their estimate.
Purposive deeds are the inspected evidence against which the estimate is corrected.

changed_reading.before: Their mistaken thought is followed by God's general awareness.
changed_reading.after: Their self-accounting is overturned by a deed-level divine audit that sees both recurrence and differentiated participation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier recurrent sequence of kindling war, divine extinguishing, and renewed striving in corruption gives the focus cycle a combustion mechanism. Divine turning functions like interruption and cooling, while the second blindness-deafness pair becomes renewed activation after that interruption; the fire branch of fitna makes the analogy internal to the focus word.

activation_trace.role: Burning and fire-blackening supply the latent combustion image within the focus test.
Reopening toward return occupies the interrupting position later illuminated by extinguishing.
Proceeding without heeding supplies the renewed momentum after interruption.
Igniting a fire supplies the recurring human activation in the contextual cycle.
Cooling flame and ember supplies the divine interruption without implying that kindling cannot recur.
Purposeful movement toward an objective supplies active resumption after extinguishing.
Departure from sound order identifies the functional result of the renewed striving.

structural_cues: The sequence كُلَّمَا أَوْقَدُوا ... أَطْفَأَهَا اللَّهُ ... وَيَسْعَوْنَ in 5:64 anticipates the two closures separated by divine turning in 5:71.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent ignition, divine extinguishing, renewed corruptive striving, and the focus reopening-reclosure sequence. I assign extinguishing as a functional analogue of divine reopening and renewed striving as an analogue of resealing. Alternative: the war-fire cycle may remain a parallel social pattern rather than the causal content of the focus relapse.

changed_reading.before: The repeated blindness and deafness are a bare relapse.
changed_reading.after: The relapse is a recurrent reactivation: divine intervention cools an active crisis, but the unheeding practice can kindle again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding history specifies what the sensory closure filters out: each arriving messenger confronts desire, after which the audience divides into denial and killing. Fitna therefore arrives as unwelcome address, and blindness-deafness names the refusal mechanisms by which desire prevents that address from becoming guidance.

activation_trace.role: Assay and discrimination supply the exposure performed by unwelcome address.
Loss of insight supplies failure to recognize the path disclosed by the messenger.
Non-hearing and non-attention supply refusal of the arriving message.
Messenger and message supply the repeated incoming address against which response is tested.
Inclination of the self supplies the selective criterion that rejects what it does not desire.
Assigning falsehood supplies the verbal disposal of one class of unwelcome messengers.
Taking life supplies the bodily disposal of the other class of unwelcome messengers.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding كُلَّمَا and paired فَرِيقًا ... وَفَرِيقًا establish repetition and differentiated response before the repeated pair and كَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ in 5:71.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated messengers, conflict with desire, bifurcated rejection, and then blindness-deafness. I infer that the sensory pair is the internal reception failure corresponding to the external denial or killing. Alternative: 5:70 may describe historical acts while 5:71 names their consequence rather than the same operative filter.

changed_reading.before: They became generally unreceptive after a mistaken expectation.
changed_reading.after: Desire screens the messenger: what challenges the self becomes the assay, and blindness-deafness is the reception system that rejects it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same delivered revelation produces divergent outcomes: it increases excess and truth-covering in many, while a moderate group remains possible. This contextual differentiation realizes the focus assay and explains why the second closure is quantified as many rather than assigned to every member.

activation_trace.role: Testing that distinguishes sound from unsound supplies the model of divergent response.
The many supply one measured outcome of the assay without exhausting the group.
Delivery and conveyance supply the common input whose reception differentiates hearers.
Increase and growth supply the paradoxical amplification produced in resistant recipients.
Crossing the limit in disobedience names one amplified response to revelation.
Covering the truth names the obscuring response that corresponds to the focus blindness.
Moderation between extremes supplies the contrasting subgroup that prevents totalization.

structural_cues: 5:66 distinguishes a moderate community from many whose work is evil, while 5:68 says the delivered revelation increases many in excess and covering; 5:71 again marks many after the test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one delivered word and sharply divergent group responses. I identify that divergence as the functional assay denied in 5:71. Alternative: fitna may denote a later punishment caused by rejection rather than revelation's differentiating effect itself.

changed_reading.before: They assumed that an external trial would not strike them.
changed_reading.after: They missed that revelation itself can be the assay: one input discloses moderation in some and amplifies resistant closure in many.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later direct question inviting repentance and seeking forgiveness clarifies the center of the focus cycle. Divine turning is not merely a completed cancellation before final relapse; it opens a return channel that is voiced again even after severe doctrinal warning.

activation_trace.role: Calling another toward return supplies the opened response channel at the cycle's center.
The explicit interrogative summons to repent makes the return channel audible after renewed error.
Covering the fault while protecting its bearer supplies the reparative effect available through return.
Merciful tenderness supplies the disposition sustaining the renewed invitation.

structural_cues: 5:74 places an open question of repentance immediately after the warnings of 5:72-73, just as divine turning interrupts closure inside 5:71.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine turning in the focus and a later explicit invitation to repent, seek covering, and meet mercy. I treat both as manifestations of a reopened response channel. Alternative: the later invitation directly addresses the speakers of 5:72-73 and need not identify every subject of 5:71.

changed_reading.before: God forgave once, after which many relapsed.
changed_reading.after: Divine turning opens a response channel that relapse does not logically abolish; the nearby discourse voices that opening again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later double command to look frames a sequence in which signs are made clear and people are then turned away. This sharpens focus blindness into post-disclosure aversion: lack of sight is not lack of available signs but a directional reversal after intelligibility.

activation_trace.role: Blindness of insight supplies inability to follow a path even when it has been disclosed.
Directing sight or insight twice supplies the observer's contrast between clarification and aversion.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies accessible intelligibility before turning away.
A manifest sign supplies the visible evidence from which the response turns.
Reversing a thing from its proper direction supplies aversion as directional displacement.

structural_cues: The construction انْظُرْ ... نُبَيِّنُ ... ثُمَّ انْظُرْ ... يُؤْفَكُونَ in 5:75 repeats sight and ثُمَّ while placing clarification before reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clear signs followed by turning and the focus supplies repeated lost insight. I infer that the blindness is resistant aversion after disclosure, not simple informational deprivation. Alternative: ثُمَّ may order the observer's two acts of looking rather than establish a psychological chronology in the observed group.

changed_reading.before: They are blind because they do not possess enough evidence.
changed_reading.after: Their blindness can occur after evidence is clarified: perception is directionally turned away from what has become legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later receptive group forms an exact functional inverse: non-arrogance precedes hearing; hearing becomes understanding; eyes overflow; recognition becomes spoken faith and witnessed commitment. The focus pair is therefore not fixed sensory incapacity but an ethical configuration whose channels can operate in the opposite direction.

activation_trace.role: Lost inward sight supplies the negative pole reversed by recognizing eyes.
Non-attention to truth supplies the negative pole reversed by understanding hearing.
Self-magnification is explicitly negated, removing a resistant posture before the receptive sequence.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies an open auditory channel rather than bare acoustics.
The seeing eye supplies the organ whose overflow visibly reverses blindness.
Easy abundant flow turns receptive recognition into an embodied surplus rather than enclosure.
Recognition by a distinguishing mark supplies successful identification of the truth.
Presence with observation carries sensory reception into accountable witness.

structural_cues: The contiguous sequence لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ... سَمِعُوا ... أَعْيُنَهُمْ تَفِيضُ ... عَرَفُوا ... آمَنَّا in 5:82-83 reverses each stage of the focus closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated pride and a hearing-eye-recognition-witness chain. I assign lowered self-magnification as an enabling posture and treat the chain as the live inverse of 5:71. Alternative: tears may mark a particular affective response without defining a general mechanism of restored perception.

changed_reading.before: Blindness and deafness describe a fixed incapacity belonging to a group.
changed_reading.after: Sight and hearing are ethical response channels: self-enclosure can shut them, while unarrogant hearing can open them into recognition and testimony.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The two-color branch of fitna is unusual and should not be presented as the direct lexical meaning here. It remains anchored in فِتْنَة and in the focus's two closure phases separated by reopening, while 5:61 supplies entry and exit between declared faith and concealed covering. Render only as an exploratory temporal image for oscillating states.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِتْنَةٌ ... فَعَمُوا وَصَمُّوا ثُمَّ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ عَمُوا وَصَمُّوا

activation_trace.role: Life in two colors supplies an exploratory image of alternating exposure states.
The reopened invitation to return supplies the hinge between the two states.
Entry into an interior supplies one side of the contextual state transition.
Passage outward supplies the other side of a transition that leaves the concealed condition intact.

changed_reading.before: Fitna is one event followed by one failure and a later relapse.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the ayah traces a two-color assay of alternating closure and reopening, exposing instability across transitions rather than only one failed moment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The choice-and-aim branch of ع م ي is derivationally distant from the surface verb and must not be used to translate عَمُوا as 'they chose.' It remains worth carrying because the focus pairs it with resolute non-listening, while nearby desire and following supply a selective mechanism. Render as possible agency within blindness, never as a settled gloss.

activation_trace.role: Choice and directed aim supply the form-distant possibility of selective rather than merely deficient seeing.
Resolute continuation without heeding supplies an agency-bearing companion to selective blindness.
Inclination of the self supplies the preference that selects which message can be received.
Following in another's track supplies the enacted direction taken under preference.
Desire's inclination supplies the directional attractor that makes non-perception selective.

changed_reading.before: Blindness is wholly involuntary absence of perception.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, blindness contains selective aim: desire directs attention away, and deaf resolve maintains the chosen trajectory.

strongest_changes: The denied fitna becomes a discriminating assay that can be performed by revelation itself.
Repeated blindness and deafness become an enacted reclosure after a genuine reopening, not uninterrupted incapacity.
The preceding messenger-desire sequence identifies unwelcome address as the input filtered by the sensory closure.
The later hearing, overflowing eyes, recognition, and witness sequence supplies a complete receptive inverse.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah contains a compact recurrence circuit: mistaken exemption, sensory self-sealing, divine reopening, quantified resealing, and divine counter-sight. The surrounding pericopes unusually externalize both the circuit's repeated ignition and its exact receptive opposite.
remaining_uncertainties: Fitna may remain punishment or social crisis rather than revelation's differentiating action itself.
The functional analogy between divine turning and extinguishing is strong structurally but is still reader-supplied.
Subject continuity across the surrounding groups is not guaranteed, so contextual mechanisms need not identify every individual in 5:71.
The two-color and selective-aim readings depend on branch-distant images and must remain exploratory.
